topics.name: 3.2.1 Grammar (Foundation tier)
points: Noun phrases: formation of feminine person nouns and plural nouns; infinitive used as a noun
Determiners: articles (agreement, contraction, partitive, de after negatives and quantities)
Other determiners: demonstrative, possessive, interrogative and indefinite adjectives
Pronouns: subject, singular direct/indirect object, singular reflexive, emphatic moi/toi, relative qui
Negation: ne…pas, ne…jamais, ne…rien, ne…personne
Interrogatives: intonation, est-ce que, verb-subject inversion
Inflectional morphology: present tense, regular and irregular forms
Inflectional morphology: perfect tense, periphrastic future (aller + infinitive), imperfect and imperative
Impersonal verbs: il y a / il y avait / il y aura, weather expressions, il faut + infinitive, telling the time
Modal verbs: devoir, pouvoir, savoir, vouloir; conditional of vouloir (singular)
Reflexive use of verbs
Adjectival phrases: gender, number and position of adjectives; regular and irregular comparatives
Adverbial phrases: position of adverbs; regular and irregular comparatives
Prepositions: à/de with verbs, en/à with place names, contractions, de for possession, pour/sans + infinitive
Derivational morphology (Reading only): ordinal numbers, prefixes in-/im-, suffixes -able, -ion/-ation, -ment

topics.name: 3.2.2 Grammar (Higher tier)
points: Articles (HT): partitive with uncountable nouns; article with dans; omission with en; aucun(e)
Pronouns (HT): y and en; plural direct and indirect object pronouns; plural emphatic and reflexive pronouns
Pronouns (HT): personne ne / rien ne; relative clauses with où, quand, que
Negation (HT): ne…plus, ne…ni…ni, ne…pas encore, ne…que
Present passive with par (HT)
Impersonal verbs (HT): adjective + de + infinitive, il manque, il vaut mieux, il vaut la peine de
être en train de and venir de (HT); reciprocal and reflexive plural verbs
Inflectional morphology (HT): connaître, écrire; depuis + present; perfect of modal verbs
Inflectional morphology (HT): future and conditional tenses; imperfect plural; imperative of être and nous-form
Present participles (HT)
Superlative adjectives and adverbs (HT)
Prepositions (HT): avant de + infinitive; après avoir + past participle
Derivational morphology (Reading only, HT): agent nouns with -eur/-ateur

topics.name: Paper 1 Listening
points: Section A: listening comprehension, questions in English answered non-verbally or in English
Section B: dictation (Foundation min. 20 words, Higher min. 30 words)

topics.name: Paper 2 Speaking
points: Part 1: role-play (five tasks)
Part 2: reading aloud task and four compulsory questions on the text
Part 3: discussion of photo card (describing two photos and unprepared conversation)

topics.name: Paper 3 Reading
points: Section A: reading comprehension, questions in English answered non-verbally or in English
Section B: translation from French into English (Foundation min. 35 words, Higher min. 50 words)

topics.name: Paper 4 Writing
points: Foundation Q1: five sentences about a photo
Foundation Q2: short text answering five compulsory bullet points (about 50 words)
Foundation Q3: gap-fill sentences choosing from three options
Translation from English into French (Foundation min. 35 words, Higher min. 50 words)
Structured writing task with three compulsory bullets (about 90 words)
Higher Q3: open-ended writing task with two compulsory bullets (about 150 words)
